jobs.title: PHYSICIAN ASSISTANT
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Physician Assistant (PA)

**Company Name:** Sri Narayani Hospital \& Research Centre, Vellore.

**Job Summary:**  
The Physician Assistant provides comprehensive healthcare services to patients by conducting examinations, diagnosing and treating illnesses, ordering and interpreting diagnostic tests, prescribing medications, and collaborating with physicians and other healthcare professionals to deliver high\-quality patient care.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Obtain and document patient medical histories.
* Perform physical examinations and assess patient health conditions.
* Diagnose and treat acute and chronic illnesses.
* Order, perform, and interpret laboratory tests and diagnostic procedures. Develop and implement treatment plans.
* Prescribe medications and therapies in accordance with regulations and organizational policies.
* Educate patients and families regarding medical conditions, treatments, and preventive care.
* Assist physicians during medical procedures and surgeries as required.
* Maintain accurate and timely medical records.
* Coordinate patient care with physicians, nurses, specialists, and other healthcare providers.
* Participate in quality improvement and patient safety initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Physician Assistant Studies, 0–3 years of relevant clinical experience.

**To apply:**

**Contact:** 8438252589 / 7358387160

**Email:** recruitment@snhrc.org / hr.snhrc@gmail.com

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Biomedical Technician
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled and responsible **Treatment Technician** to perform treatments using various machines and equipment as per the prescribed treatment protocols. The technician will be responsible for operating equipment safely, assisting clients/patients during treatments, maintaining treatment standards, and ensuring proper care and hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform treatments using the designated machines and equipment according to established protocols.
* Understand and operate treatment machines safely and effectively.
* Prepare the machine, treatment room, and required materials before each session.
* Explain the basic treatment procedure to clients/patients and provide appropriate instructions before and after treatment.
* Follow treatment settings, duration, intensity, and procedures as instructed by the doctor/therapist/supervisor.
* Monitor the client/patient during the treatment and immediately report any discomfort, adverse reaction, or unusual response.
* Maintain proper hygiene, cleanliness, and sanitation of treatment areas and equipment.
* Clean, disinfect, and safely store machines and accessories after use.
* Check machines regularly and report any malfunction, damage, or maintenance requirement.
* Maintain accurate treatment records, including treatment performed, machine/settings used, and session details.
* Follow all company safety procedures, treatment protocols, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure proper handling and care of all treatment equipment.
* Coordinate with doctors, therapists, or senior staff when required.
* Maintain a professional, courteous, and client\-focused approach at all times.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Company:** Bruhat Logistics Private Limited  
**Job Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Department:** Operations \& Documentation  
**Industry:** Logistics / Freight Forwarding / Project Cargo  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Company

Bruhat Logistics is a Singapore\-headquartered international freight forwarding and project cargo logistics company, specializing in providing customized and efficient logistics solutions across global markets.

With an established international presence across Asia, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, and the Americas, we offer end\-to\-end multimodal transportation solutions through air, sea, and land.

At Bruhat Logistics, we are committed to delivering reliable, innovative, and customer\-focused logistics services while providing our employees with opportunities for professional development and industry exposure.

Job Description

We are looking for a proactive, detail\-oriented, and enthusiastic **Operations Executive** to join our Operations \& Documentation team. The selected candidate will be responsible for coordinating shipment activities, managing import/export operations, maintaining shipment documentation, and ensuring smooth communication between clients, vendors, and internal teams.

The role offers an excellent opportunity to gain practical exposure to international freight forwarding operations, particularly Air and Sea Imports.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities

* Handle day\-to\-day shipment operations and ensure smooth execution of freight forwarding activities.
* Coordinate with clients, shipping lines, airlines, vendors, and internal departments to facilitate timely shipment movement.
* Monitor shipment progress and provide regular updates to clients regarding shipment status, transit schedules, and delivery timelines.
* Manage operational activities and documentation associated with Air and Sea Import shipments.
* Coordinate with vendors and logistics service providers to plan and execute shipments according to client requirements.
* Identify and resolve shipment\-related challenges, operational delays, and unexpected issues through effective crisis management.
* Ensure timely preparation, verification, and maintenance of shipment\-related documents.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and operational reports.
* Work closely with the Sales, Pricing, and Documentation teams to ensure seamless coordination and customer satisfaction.
* Ensure operational activities are completed within agreed timelines while maintaining service quality.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination and interpersonal skills.
* Basic understanding of logistics, supply chain management, or freight forwarding operations.
* Good problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to handle multiple shipments and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Customer\-focused approach with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
* Willingness to learn international shipping procedures and operational documentation.
* Experience 0\-2 Years in Logistics and Freight Forwarding filed

What We Offer

* Exposure to international freight forwarding and project cargo operations.
* Opportunities to work with global clients, vendors, and overseas teams.
* Practical learning in Air and Sea operations.
* A collaborative and professional work environment.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, skill development, and career growth within the logistics industry.
